**EL-RSP-P3 RearLightLIN slot gap**

The RearLightLIN schedule table shall let at most 30 ms pass between the starts of two consecutive DEVMLIN01Fr01 slots, with slots of at most 10 ms at 19.2 kbit/s.

description: Platform part of EL-RSP-1.4 (RearLight_IndicatorResponseTime), through CommunicateAllocation_RearLightLIN, which places the ReqLeft and ReqRight assemblies of RearLight on RearLightLIN.
DEVMLIN01Schedule01 in rearlight.ldf runs DEVMLIN01Fr01 at 0, 20 and 40 ms of a 70 ms table. The longest gap is 30 ms, from 40 ms to the next table start:
Adding a frame to the 40–70 ms span without repeating DEVMLIN01Fr01 uses up the 25 ms margin of EL-RSP-1.
